notes.title: Update #3: Oculus
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/2e30873ba7fa5b68cc94972f437da2c84a870c6c.png[/img]

[h1]Just released support for Oculus + Touch Controllers.[/h1] ːsteamhappyː

This is just first stage of integration. We are still using Valve's OpenVR for Oculus HMD, but it's fully playable now.
Later we plan to fully integrate Oculus SDK for native support.

In the next update we plan to add visual representation of Oculus Touch controllers, now in-game it looks the same as with Vive's.
We have made 2 concept arts for controllers, will be great to get opinion.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/589e42c332a76f68394457b4ec6abe48b8e94cd7.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/b448a573c155f4b741288c5f0425bea64c6c7c35.png[/img]

We find out that for some players - height may not work correctly, you can try to install beta patch. 
[b]NOT RECOMMENDED TO INSTALL FOR PLAYERS WHO HAS CORRECT HEIGHT IN GAME.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdJhpYPU4Js8944/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update #2: Level 4
notes.content:

Hey, we just released our new update for RedCubeVR game :) sorry to keep you waiting, had some works with fixing bugs.

[i]Version v0.2 Release notes:[/i]

[i]Fixes and small features:[/i]
[b]-New music in Level 1
-Optimized texture resolutions in previous levels - for better quality and performance
-Added glowing trail to sword
-Fixed few steam achievements
-Fixed "Shield" bonus bug - few users had problems with shooting while shield is activated.
-Fixed "Slowdown" bonus - when we die, it resets now properly.[/b]

[i]Main update features:[/i]
[b]-Added new Level 4 - it is a completely new in-game location. The main features are - openness and large size.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/99548dfb5e81c3a95025d8898ab17aee246757b3.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGjK9wECizu1DPi/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]-Added new enemy: "Grenade".
It flies like projectile and have big explosion force.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/01e52c629d51616a793087708ac6fa79f065ff17.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGHRrM3IpknTihy/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]-Added new weapon: "Laser".
Fast, powerful, have good attack distance, but needs accuracy.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/3878eea95e59c3b7173b47e44e57fb75d68d35ff.png[/img]

notes.title: Weapons in REDCUBE VR
notes.content:
Hey. This is second post about in-game content and today's topic is - weapons. ːsteamhappyː
The game has different types of weapons that can be used against enemies. What kinds of weapons are available to the player depends on the in-game location in which we are currently located. Each level has it's own set of weapons and bonuses.

[h1]Weapons that are already integrated[/h1]

[b] Pistol.[/b]
Has infinity ammo, shoots not very fast, but has a good damage rate.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/c2b96fdba6482060d9c63b635fa4ac795ad50769.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7builnYHfaFj6DXW/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Mashinegun.[/b]
Has low damage rate, but very fast shoot rate. Also has energy, shown as glowing lines on gun itself. When we start shooting, lines are getting darker and energy starts decreasing and when we release button - it starts restoring power to its full condition.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/e3c21c9c389409392f0a32b1a4536ed4b903c982.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0Iy4WcnyLD1THsqc/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Sword.[/b]
Perfect melee gun for short ranges, kills with one hit.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/92ec275362ed19500c7ebfa6c0fe413729e940e4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7btQ0uE9HTY8H8VG/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Freezer.[/b]
Special weapon, that sprays liquid nitrogen and freezes opponents.
Can only be obtained from bonus boxes spawned in level.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/018ea3adefadbcda18f968431cd2d381e1382e90.jpg[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7bu95MVJTTbCmNji/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Weapons - work in progress[/h1]
This is weapons - we are currently working on. It will be available in future updates.

[b]Laser.[/b]
Can burn opponents.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/38130aeb18855933b742a126eb79867618f601ff.jpg[/img]

[b]Hand Shield.[/b]
Can be used to defend yourself from shooting enemies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/282a60a6ea3f8db51e65107977b66f6bd446cec2.jpg[/img]

[b]Gravitygun.[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660068/60489dd6f764ed72dda46e22b91e405ae1b7a895.jpg[/img]
We try to create our own gravity gun, to manipulate dynamic objects and enemies in scene. It is inspired by HL2 gravity gun:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0IxZw4wV4cpFb4Va/giphy.gif[/img]

Thanks for following. Next post will be about bonus objects :)
